summary: Issue a certificate again at another CA

parameters.name: certID
parameters.description: ID of the Let's Encrypt certificate, as the list shows it

200.description: The certificate with its new CA and expiry

400.description: Not a Certbot certificate, the CA is not set up (error.acme-ca-not-allowed) or is the certificate's own (error.acme-same-ca)

description:
Issues a Let's Encrypt certificate again at another CA an administrator set up, with the same names and challenge, and reloads nginx. The old certificate is revoked at its old CA afterwards. If the new CA fails, nothing changes. It waits for the ACME server, which can take minutes.

Needs: Certificates manage

requestBody.description: The CA to issue the certificate at

npmpro_acme_server.description: The CA to issue at, one of the CAs the acme-servers list offers; it must differ from the certificate's CA
